prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy conservation-documentation photograph in a shallowly flooded museum gallery. Image 1 is visible-appearance guidance only for an original adult fictional woman, whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. She kneels with one hand stabilizing a complete closed magic circle inlaid directly into wet marble. Show a surface-anchored magic circle enforcing a local rule: one complete closed boundary remains visible without cropped gaps on marble; the boundary conforms to a real floor wall table or object surface beneath shallow water; light material motion or state differs visibly inside versus outside across the water; the fictional effect terminates bends or changes exactly at the boundary line along the flooded marble floor; dust liquid shadow scorch or object contact records the local rule along wet marble. Still luminous water lies inside and ordinary ripples outside, with damp dust and a narrow scorch trace at the line. Beside her, one complete articulated suit of living armor independently lifts a fallen gilded frame from the water. Show visibly hollow articulated living armor: helmet torso arm and leg armor form one complete shell in view; overlapping plates and joint gaps bend coherently at shoulders elbows hips and knees during the lift; an open visor neck gap or gauntlet opening reveals empty interior volume under gallery light; balanced posture contact shadows and plate movement show unsupported agency in shallow water; a grasped object opened door or displaced dust responds to the armor above the shallow floodwater surface. The frame rises while metal feet send concentric ripples. A medium-wide diagonal view contains the whole circle, both water regions, her stabilizing hand, the full armor and its empty opening, and the frame; cool skylight plus restrained amber circle light separates wet stone, metal, skin, and water.
